Follows links from a meta nofollow page when robots directives are disabled while retaining detection fields

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using Crawlberg;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var engineConfig = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CrawlConfig>("{\"max_depth\":1,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}", ConfigOptions)!;
var engine = CrawlbergConverter.CreateEngine(engineConfig);
var url = "https://example.com";
var result = await CrawlbergConverter.CrawlAsync(engine, url);
Console.WriteLine(result.Pages.Count);
Console.WriteLine(result.Pages[0].NofollowDetected);
Console.WriteLine(result.Pages[0].NoindexDetected);
Console.WriteLine(result.Pages[1].NofollowDetected);
```
